implementation_notes: Each edge is a package with its own name (`@acme/identity-acl`), dependency-cruiser rules encode the map, and `exports` maps keep each package's surface narrow. Separate ways is an explicit forbidden-import rule.
idiom_name: one package per edge + dependency-cruiser rules mirroring the map
code_sketch:
// .dependency-cruiser.js
{ name: 'separate-ways', from: { path: '^src/reporting' }, to: { path: '^src/billing' }, forbidden: true }
pitfalls: Wildcard barrel exports letting consumers bypass the ACL and call the upstream directly
